title: Aten Ha Ra progression / Akhevan Warders
summary: Clear Vex Thal's warder gates before attempting the proper Aten Ha Ra encounter.
overview: Clear Vex Thal's warder gates before attempting the proper Aten Ha Ra encounter.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Complete the warder progression before approaching Aten's room.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Kaas Thox Xi Ans Dyek, Diabo Xi Xin Thall, Thall Va Kelun and Va Xi Aten Ha Ra each remove a required warder on death.
Diabo Xi Va Temariel and Thall Xundraux Diabo remove the shared fourth warder gate.
The trigger checks every fifteen seconds and summons the proper Aten only when all five required warders are absent.
While a required warder remains, the trigger selects the dangerous alternate Aten instead.

notes: Approval E391. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
This draft documents warder progression and variant selection; it does not claim distinct Aten combat mechanics absent from the reviewed trigger.
